# Exo Launcher support

Start with [Getting started and help](../docs/HELP.md) for installation, stores, Music, Discord, Devices, and account questions.

- [Download the latest release](https://github.com/ImAvgErix/ExoLauncher/releases/latest)
- [Check supported features](../docs/SUPPORT_MATRIX.md)
- [Report a problem or suggest a feature](https://github.com/ImAvgErix/ExoLauncher/issues/new/choose)

Issues are public. Remove private account details from screenshots and log excerpts before posting.
